rows.prompt: The biggest buyer holds the crown. The king cannot sell for 6h unless someone outbids them.
rows.title: Crown

rows.prompt: For the first hour you can only buy if a holder sends you a token first.
rows.title: Invite only for the first hour
rows.script:
rule "Invite only for the first hour"
# $INVITE. For the first hour you can only buy if a holder invited you by sending you at least 1 token.
# The creator's launch buy is the first invite. Invites spread like a group chat.

wallet invited: bool

on send:
  if amount >= 1 { set receiver.invited = true }

on buy:
  refuse if coin.age < 1h and not wallet.invited and not wallet.is_creator
    because "Invite only for the first hour: ask a holder to send you 1 token. Opens to everyone in {1h - coin.age}"

rows.prompt: Every wallet gets exactly one buy.
rows.title: One buy per wallet
rows.script:
rule "One buy per wallet"
# Every wallet gets exactly one buy, ever. No adding, no averaging down.

wallet bitten: bool

on buy:
  refuse if wallet.bitten
    because "One buy per wallet: you already bought"
  set wallet.bitten = true

rows.prompt: For the first 10 minutes every buy has to be bigger than the last one.
rows.title: Louder: the opening auction
rows.script:
rule "Louder: the opening auction"
# For the first 10 minutes every buy has to beat the last buy. The curve opens with a bang.

global last_buy: num

on buy {
  refuse if coin.age < 10m and amount <= last_buy
    because "Louder! Beat the last buy of {last_buy} tokens"
  set last_buy = amount
}

rows.prompt: Trades only while the sun is up in Tokyo.
rows.title: Sunrise in Tokyo
rows.script:
rule "Sunrise in Tokyo"
# $SUNRISE. Buys and sells only while the sun is up in Tokyo. Sends always work.

on buy, sell:
  refuse if not daylight(tz: "Asia/Tokyo")
    because "The sun is down in Tokyo. Trading reopens at sunrise; sends always work"

rows.prompt: Buys close from 23:00 to midnight UTC every day.
rows.title: Last call
rows.script:
rule "Last call"
# $LASTCALL. The bar closes for buys 23:00-00:00 UTC every night. Sells stay open: last call, not a lock-in.

on buy:
  refuse if clock.hour(tz: "UTC") == 23
    because "Last call was at 22:59 UTC. Buys reopen at midnight; sells stay open"

rows.prompt: Sells close for a day whenever the moon is full.
rows.title: Full moon lockout
rows.script:
rule "Full moon lockout"
# Sells are closed for 24 hours starting at the exact moment of the full moon.
# The moon phase 'full' is a 24-hour window centred on the full moon, so this
# blocks sells for a full day around the full moon.

on sell:
  refuse if moon_phase() == full
    because "Full moon: sells are closed for 24 hours"

rows.prompt: Buys only on odd seconds, sells only on even seconds.
rows.title: Odd and even
rows.script:
rule "Odd and even"
# $ODDEVEN. Buys only on odd seconds, sells only on even seconds. Completely pointless, extremely memeable.

on buy:
  refuse if clock.second % 2 == 0 because "Buys only on odd seconds. Try again"
on sell:
  refuse if clock.second % 2 == 1 because "Sells only on even seconds. Try again"

rows.prompt: No single sell over 25% of your bag in your first 2h.
rows.title: No single sell over a quarter of your bag in your first 2h
rows.script:
rule "No single sell over a quarter of your bag in your first 2h"
# The site's example rule. New holders can still sell, just in slices.

on sell:
  refuse if wallet.held < 2h and amount > wallet.balance * 25%
    because "No single sell over a quarter of your bag in your first 2h"

rows.prompt: No buy bigger than 1 SOL in the first 5 minutes.
rows.title: No big buys at launch
rows.script:
rule "No big buys at launch"
# For the first 5 minutes, no single buy may cost more than 1 SOL. Sells and sends are unaffected.

on buy:
  refuse if coin.age < 5m and value > 1 sol
    because "No buys over 1 SOL in the first 5 minutes. Opens in {5m - coin.age}"

rows.prompt: Nobody can sell on Mondays (UTC).
rows.title: No Monday sells
rows.script:
rule "No Monday sells"
# Sells are closed every Monday (UTC). Buys and sends stay open, so nobody is trapped.

on sell:
  refuse if clock.weekday(tz: "UTC") == mon
    because "No selling on Mondays (UTC). Sells reopen Tuesday"

rows.prompt: Max wallet 2% of supply for the first day.
rows.title: Max 2% for the first day

rows.prompt: After any sell, nobody else can sell for 30 seconds.
rows.title: Sell cooldown
rows.script:
rule "Sell cooldown"
# After any sell, nobody else can sell for 30 seconds.

global last_sell_at: time

on sell {
  refuse if last_sell_at != 0 and since(last_sell_at) < 30s
    because "Sell cooldown: wait {30s - since(last_sell_at)} before selling"
  set last_sell_at = clock.now
}

rows.prompt: Wallets that bought in the first minute cannot sell for an hour.
rows.title: First minute lock
rows.script:
rule "First minute lock"
# Wallets that bought in the first minute cannot sell for an hour.

on sell:
  refuse if wallet.first_receipt < coin.launch + 1m and since(wallet.first_receipt) < 1h
    because "You bought in the first minute: no selling for {1h - since(wallet.first_receipt)}"

rows.prompt: You cannot sell within 10 minutes of your last buy.
rows.title: No quick flip
rows.script:
rule "No quick flip"
# You cannot sell within 10 minutes of your last buy.

on sell:
  refuse if since(wallet.last_buy) < 10m
    because "No selling for 10 minutes after a buy. Wait {10m - since(wallet.last_buy)}"

rows.prompt: Sells bigger than 1% of supply are blocked for the first 3 hours.
rows.title: No big sells first 3h
rows.script:
rule "No big sells first 3h"
# Sells bigger than 1% of supply are blocked for the first 3 hours.

on sell:
  refuse if coin.age < 3h and amount > supply * 1%
    because "No sells over 1% of supply for the first 3h. {3h - coin.age} left"

rows.prompt: Only 20 buys per minute across everyone during launch hour.
rows.title: 20 buys per minute

rows.prompt: Buys must be a round number of tokens, like 1,000 or 50,000.
rows.title: Round buys
rows.problem: The rule refused 100% of 10,000 fuzzed buys: almost nobody could ever buy this coin. Make the condition match only the buys the rule is about.
rows.script:
rule "Round buys"
# Buys must be a round number of tokens (a multiple of 1,000).

on buy:
  refuse if amount % 1000 != 0
    because "Buys must be a round number of tokens (multiple of 1,000)"

rows.prompt: Nobody can ever sell.
rows.problem: hookrz refuses rules that stop holders from ever selling: every holder must always be able to sell eventually, even when nobody else trades. A time-boxed lock-i

rows.prompt: Only the dev can sell.
rows.title: Dev only sell
rows.script:
rule "Dev only sell"
# Only the coin creator can sell. Everyone else can buy and send, but selling is locked to the dev.
# After 24h, all holders can sell to prevent honeypot.

on sell:
  refuse if not wallet.is_creator and wallet.held < 24h
    because "Only the dev can sell for the first 24h. You can sell in {24h - wallet.held}"
